reviews.title: Great App! No Customer Service.
reviews.text: Great app and super motivating! I would give it a 5 out of 5 review if it was not for the customer service. Six attempts to reach Shred over 2 weeks about a glitch in the software. I did all usually fixes - log out/in, hard stop, power off/on, removed app, etc. Only responses are automated responses saying they will respond in 24-48 hours. Zero customer support!!!

reviews.title: Degraded Quality
reviews.text:
Have been using this app for about 5 months and have enjoyed it, but the quality has gone down and they’re not improving features quickly enough. The AI coach voice that gives instructions has gotten weird in the last few weeks, sounding robotic and sometimes British (not the coach I have selected). 

Also, we’ve been asking for muscle group heatmaps for months and they’re not delivering. 

I emails support about the voice issue and haven’t heard back. Can’t recommend this app anymore and considering changing.

reviews.title: Not gonna resubscribe
reviews.text: This app got me started and that’s awesome but I’ve discovered so many problems. Ask AI about this app before putting money down. This app will not push data for some workouts or it will do it hours later with wrong data like it never ended the workout. Maybe because I hit end workout then when I go back in later to download my pic the end button is there like I never it hit. What’s my PR for bench press? I don’t know and the app doesn’t keep track for PR for the user. It will tell you when you hit a PR but you can’t go back and look at your PR’s. Often I get instructions in English follows by instructions in random unrecognizable Slavic sounding languages. If I tap the video the text doesn’t go away anymore forcing me to go into full screen mode. Doesn’t always show enough angles. I’m often wondering where my hands are supposed to be. There is no settings or ability to enlarge text even though theres plenty of blank space. Whatever next year I’m trying Fitbod

reviews.title: Membership Cancelled - glitchy and useless ai
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the app for almost a year now and over the past few months it has become extremely glitchy

The ai does not make adjustments to workouts despite that being advertised, i think I’ve told it over 5 times over the past few months to give me more machine oriented workouts (yes the relevant equipment is selected in settings) and it just doesn’t listen despite giving a confirmation “the next workout will include more machine oriented workouts”

The phone app and apple watch app lose sync causing incorrect data being written to apple health

The apps buttons just stop working during workouts, clicking next before a rest doesn’t go to rest but the next workout begins. Force quitting restores functionality but I’ve had a workout completely reset as a result OR the app recovers but the apple watch app thinks you have the workout paused

Not sure if the devs have embraced vibe coding recently, but recent app performance tells me “probably”

Canceling membership and going back to traditional workout tracking, really wanted this app to work out!

reviews.title: Why so complicated
reviews.text: I just want to workout and be healthy. The gym isn’t a “lifestyle”. I have a life. I just want to go to the gym to stay healthy and have an app help me. This thing requires all your info, exactly what weights and machines are at your gym. Min 3 days per week. What if I start with 1? Does that make me a bad person and shouldn’t use the app?!? Why can’t I just say. I’m looking for a general all around workout schedule. When I come back next is my next workout regardless of the days in between. I don’t want daily notifications and a constant email. I’m not looking to join a community. I just want to be a little healthier than I am now. Why is that so hard for you fanatics to understand!!

reviews.text:
I downloaded this app using a promo code, but Apple Pay kept bouncing back the charges. After the two week trial I was essentially kicked out, but I pressed the button to re-enroll and this time it worked but only at full price. I wrote to customer service for two issues- this issue with the billing, and about a creepy guy harassing me and wanting to exchange photos. I asked for help with a block function to keep him from viewing my account and messaging me. I never heard back. For an app that costs over 100 dollars a year I really expected support when I needed it.

Once again, I am being harassed by a fellow member and have no response from customer support. There needs to be a blocking feature.

reviews.title: Had High Hopes, but Ultimately Disappointed
reviews.text:
This app consistently has failed to impress me. Today’s malfunction has made me seriously consider deleting the app and asking for a refund. 

For the last 4 workouts I’ve tried to ask my “Coach” a question and my question won’t submit. When I finally finish the workout, my question can finally be submitted. The coaches are one of the main selling points for this app so to not have access to one is annoying. 

My calories weren’t properly tracked for my workout out today. At the end of my workout it was stated that I burned 200+ calories. Yet, when I looked at my Fitness+ app it was showing that I burned ZERO calories. I tried to look back on this app to find the calories that I burned, but I can’t see that information when I look at my previous workouts.

reviews.title: Not for everyone as suggested
reviews.text: No tutorial on how to use app. Its ok, figured it in a few days. I dont like this app, heres why: I listed my available home gym equipment and for the most part Shred followed what I have available but when I went to look ahead and preview my workouts, the app would tell me the next workout isn’t available that I have to update my equipment to continue.? I have a bench press squat rack 300lbs of plates and dumbbells up to 55 pounds,curl bars, straight bars, landmine stuff etc. Shred kept trying to build me programs with equipment I didn’t have. It was bit of a nuisance, and to much of a pain to try and fix their programs mid workout to suit the equipment I have. Shreds not for everyone like they say it is.

reviews.title: I want to like it

I’ve put in the equipment I have which is very limited but it’s still trying to give me workouts which require proper machines at the gym. You’re telling me there isn’t exercises that can work backs and biceps using dumbbell’s???!! It’s absolutely ridiculous. What is the point of putting in the equipment you have if it doesn’t even give you those workouts?? You think I have a smith machine at home? Well if I did then I would have put it into my available equipment. I’m on the 7 day trial before I have to pay for the year.  If it does that again in the next workout I will cancel the trial and look for another app!

reviews.title: Great for Beginner - Benefits Drop Off Fast
reviews.text:
Shred has good intentions and a decent interface, but the core functionality is surprisingly underdeveloped for a paid fitness app.

My biggest issue is the app prioritizing an unnecessary AI chatbot instead of fixing basic workout programming tools. There is very limited ability to control exercise parameters such as sets, reps, time, and circuit structure. The most frustrating bug is that when you swap an exercise manually, the app often fails to update the set format correctly. For example, if you replace an isometric hold with a rep-based exercise, it will still display a time requirement instead of reps.

The search function is also very weak. Even when you enter the exact name of an exercise that exists in the app, it often fails to return it. The search only works with single words, which forces you to scroll through dozens of exercises to find what you need.

Programming for hypertrophy is inaccurate as well. Rather than distributing volume properly across the week (12–20 sets per muscle group), the app gives some muscle groups too much work and others too little.

There is also a social “cheer” feature that could be fun, but the “cheer all” button does not consistently work.

My honest recommendation is to only subscribe month-to-month and only if you are a beginner. I committed to a year and regret it. Until the developers fix the basics, the AI features feel like a distraction from what really matters: reliable workout programming.
